lines.quote: Develop phased-array beamforming algorithms for Polaris's 24-element S-band active antenna module: steering vector computation, sidelobe suppression, and array calibration

I wrote the real-time beamforming controller in C for a TI C6748 DSP — a fixed-point pipeline handling steering weight computation and application at frame rate, with hard real-time constraints and no FPU.
developed automated beamformer validation and regression testing tools using NumPy, SciPy, and pytest; integrated with Jenkins CI for nightly runs across Polaris's DSP team
Conduct RF characterisation of antenna elements and sub-arrays using Keysight N5224B PNA network analyser and near-field scanning in Polaris's anechoic chamber
Experience with satellite and airborne platform integration.

requirements.name: Team-lead experience

lines.quote: Led a team of six DSP engineers as Head of DSP at Polaris RF Labs, driving algorithm development and system validation for active antenna products.

requirements.note: The profile section claims a 'Head of DSP' leadership title leading a team of six engineers, but the work-history entry for the same employer and period lists the role as 'Signal Processing Engineer' with individual-contributor-style bullet points (developing algorithms, applying methods, conducting characterisation). The text does not reconcile these two accounts of the role; recorded as a contradiction without resolving which is correct.
